evidence_policy: Cited original lines are re-supplied. Facts are hypotheses checked against code. A partial view is not a complete-function absence proof.

joined_facts.statement: For inputs of at least eight configuration bytes, the harness treats the remaining bytes as Markdown. Mode 0 passes them to cmark_parse_document with their explicit length.
The harness masks parsing options to the listed bits, including CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8. Eight zero configuration bytes select mode 0 with that option unset.
The harness also offers file parsing, chunked parser feeding, and Markdown-to-HTML modes. The Markdown-to-HTML helper delegates to cmark_parse_document.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows that the Markdown-to-HTML mode uses document parsing.

joined_facts.statement: Document parsing feeds the supplied buffer and length into S_parser_feed, then finishes and frees the parser.

evidence.dependency_reason: Connects the harness's document parse call to block input processing.

joined_facts.statement: The supplied after-source scanner fragment contains a state that returns type 7 and separate states processing quoted attribute values. The fragment alone does not establish which input bytes reach those states.

CommonMark rendering emits an HTML block node's literal content; LaTeX rendering has an HTML block case that emits nothing. A difference in block recognition can therefore affect target rendering, conditional on the parser creating a different node.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the CommonMark renderer's handling of a recognized HTML block.
Shows the LaTeX renderer's handling of a recognized HTML block.
Shows that the harness invokes both renderers for a parsed document.

joined_facts.statement: The supplied recipe configures CMake, builds cmark_static, and links the harness object with build/src/libcmark.a.

evidence.dependency_reason: Fixes the target's supplied build route.

joined_facts.statement: The complete harness has no explicit assertion comparing the recognized block type or rendered output. It guards rendering on a non-null document.

The entry treats a leading configuration struct as options and width, then uses the remaining bytes as Markdown. Mode 0 calls cmark_parse_document; modes 1 and 2 use file and incremental parsing; mode 3 calls cmark_markdown_to_html.
The harness masks options to the listed CMARK_OPT bits, including CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8. An all-zero configuration header selects mode 0 with options and width zero.
The supplied recipe builds cmark_static with CMake, compiles fuzz/cmark-fuzz.c, and links it with libcmark.a into cmark_fuzzer.

On both source versions, open_new_blocks tries the type 7 scanner only when the line is not indented, the container is not a paragraph, and maybe_lazy is false. A successful match creates an HTML block and stores the returned block type.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the container, laziness and indentation state used by the scanner gate.

joined_facts.statement: The before type 7 scanner has a path for a valid two-byte UTF-8 sequence inside a double-quoted attribute value: a lead byte from C2–DF followed by a continuation byte returns to the quoted-value state. A closing quote, `>`, and line ending can then produce return value 7.

The after scanner's byte map marks bytes 80–FF with value 224, which includes the quoted-value loop's bit 64. Thus a valid non-ASCII UTF-8 attribute value can pass through the double-quoted path; a closing quote, `>`, and line ending can still produce return value 7. The changed scanner does not itself establish the claimed missed block start for this condition.

The harness supplies the same Markdown bytes through document, file, incremental parser, or Markdown-to-HTML routes selected by the configuration's upper bits; these are alternate target call sequences for reaching parsing behavior.
The complete harness contains no assertion about HTML block recognition or rendered content. It checks whether doc is non-NULL before rendering, then frees each render result without inspecting it.
The entry treats the first eight bytes as options and width, then passes the remaining bytes as Markdown. Parsing mode 0 calls cmark_parse_document.
An all-zero configuration selects document parsing with CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8 clear. With that option clear, line processing copies the supplied bytes into the current line.

evidence.dependency_reason: The input bytes select the parsing route and option bits.

joined_facts.statement: The before scanner has a path that accepts a valid UTF-8 character inside a double-quoted attribute value; after the closing quote, a completed tag followed by a newline can return type 7.
The after scanner's quoted-value byte map accepts the UTF-8 bytes of é; its closing-quote and completed-tag path can return type 7 when the tag is followed by a newline.

Eight zero configuration bytes followed by the UTF-8 Markdown `<x a="é">\n` provide a finite input route to document parsing with validation disabled. Both supplied scanner versions have an accepting type 7 path for that tag shape; the supplied lines do not establish the block caller's use of the result.

evidence.dependency_reason: The prefix selects document parsing and leaves the Markdown bytes as input.

joined_facts.statement: Line processing passes its current input to open_new_blocks, and scan_html_block_start_7 is defined as a wrapper around _scan_html_block_start_7 through _scan_at. The supplied caller lines stop short of showing the type 7 guard and result handling.

evidence.dependency_reason: This establishes the block-opening call from line processing.
This defines the scanner wrapper used by the block caller.

joined_facts.statement: The complete supplied harness contains no assertion or comparison of parsed nodes or rendered output. Its explicit gates are the minimum input size and whether doc is non-null before rendering.

The harness reads a packed configuration prefix, masks the permitted option bits, and treats the remaining bytes as Markdown. An all-zero prefix selects document parsing with UTF-8 validation disabled.
The document route passes the Markdown bytes and length to cmark_parse_document, which feeds and finishes a parser.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the implementation called by the harness's document route.

joined_facts.statement: When CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8 is clear, line processing copies the supplied bytes into the parser's line buffer, so this stage does not replace an interior 0xFF byte.

evidence.dependency_reason: A zero configuration prefix supplies options without CMARK_OPT_VALIDATE_UTF8 through the document route.

joined_facts.statement: The after _scan_at wrapper rejects a null chunk pointer or offset beyond the chunk length. Otherwise it temporarily terminates the chunk, calls the supplied scanner at the offset, restores the byte, and returns the scanner result without a separate high-byte filter.

Block parsing calls scan_html_block_start_7 only for a nonindented candidate outside the paragraph and lazy-continuation gates. A nonzero result creates an HTML block and stores that result as its block type.

evidence.dependency_reason: Line processing passes the prepared chunk into open_new_blocks.

joined_facts.statement: The supplied after g0014 fragment shows a return-7 state and quoted-value states using bitmap tests, but does not show enough of the scanner's entry transitions to establish that an attribute containing 0xFF reaches that return.
The old harness also offers file and incremental parser routes. Its markdown_to_html route calls cmark_parse_document internally, providing another route to document parsing.

The after type 7 scanner's high-byte bitmap includes 0xFF in its quoted-attribute continuation path. For a scanner buffer beginning `<x a="` followed by 0xFF, `">` and a newline, that path reaches its return value 7.
The before type 7 scanner has zero high-byte bitmap entries and sends 0xFF in the double-quoted attribute path to its zero-result branch.

evidence.dependency_reason: This is the scanner's zero-result branch.

joined_facts.statement: On both source versions, scan_html_block_start_7 calls _scan_at. With nonnull chunk data and an offset within its length, _scan_at calls the scanner at that offset, restores the byte temporarily replaced at the chunk end, and returns the scanner result.

evidence.dependency_reason: The before macro connects the block parser call to the wrapper.
The after macro connects the block parser call to the wrapper.

The after wrapper forwards and returns the scanner result.

joined_facts.statement: Block parsing calls the type 7 scanner when the line is not indented, the container is not a paragraph, and `maybe_lazy` is false, after the type 1–6 scan returns zero.

evidence.dependency_reason: These lines establish the block-opening loop and indentation test.

joined_facts.statement: When that call returns 7, block parsing creates a CMARK_NODE_HTML_BLOCK and records 7 as its HTML block type. This is a concrete route against the proposed missed-start consequence, conditional on the specified bytes reaching the line buffer.

evidence.dependency_reason: The wrapper returns the scanner result to block parsing.
A nonzero type 7 scan result creates and types the HTML block.

joined_facts.statement: In the after scanner, byte 0xFF in a double quoted attribute is admitted by the high byte bitmap path. After the closing quote, '>', and newline, the scanner can return type 7.

The same old harness provides direct document, file, incremental, and HTML conversion parsing routes; a claim that it cannot supply this byte through any route is refuted by its mode selection and option handling.
